\section{What the analysis notices}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.4em]
  \item \finding{warning} \texttt{halo\_exchange/?} reports 0 messages but the fabric logged 6: the collective's own accounting disagrees with the traffic it produced.
  \item \finding{warning} Concurrency never exceeded one rank despite a world size of 4: this ran serially.
  \item \finding{note} Collectives account for 76.4\% of the run's rank-seconds, so more of the pool's time went to coordination than to work.
  \item \finding{ok} All 9 checkable collective(s) sent exactly the number of messages their closed-form cost expression predicts.
\end{itemize}
